title: Netsells: co-founder and CEO
body: Built a York digital product consultancy working with Trainline, Coca-Cola, Uber, the BBC and Red Bull Racing. Ranked ninth fastest-growing technology business in the North of England by GP Bullhound.

title: YourParkingSpace: CPO, COO, then CEO
body: Led product and technology from 2016, operations from 2022 and the whole business as CEO from 2023.

title: Railguard: co-founder
body: Co-founded and seed-funded a rail-tech business automating delay repay claims for travel management companies. Sold to Trainline in 2019.

title: Investing and board work
body: Angel investor, adviser and board member across software, fintech, health, consumer and leisure, including Ryzon, Stasher, Truvi, Odhealth and Brawn Power. Exits include Railguard and Wombat.

title: Netsells merges with hedgehog lab
body: A merger backed by BGF. Continued as investor and advisor to the enlarged group.

title: Flowbird Group: executive committee
body: Part of the deal team for the sale of Flowbird to EasyPark Group, now Arrive, alongside Ringo, Parkopedia and ParkMobile. Stepped down in December 2024 after US antitrust clearance.

title: The Good Golf Company: COO
body: Chief Operating Officer of a UK golf business.

title: Anyway Ventures: founding partner
body: The AI practice: technology and AI due diligence, fractional AI operating partner roles and embedded AI delivery for PE-backed and mid-market businesses.
